requirements.quote: Add layer M5 to packages/validators/src/memory.ts (MEMORY_LAYERS, LAYER_SCOPES user/workspace, M5 keys) and the memory_item layer/scope CHECKs

add precedent_passage table (id, workspace_id, memory_item_id, court_id, kind, language, body, source_draft_version_id, anchor_id, status) with migration, RLS and clerk denial, chamber-sharing only when owner shared
packages/core/src/memory/m5/{playbook,precedent-bank,proposals}.ts (passage saved only via confirmed L2 proposal; dismissal reason code, no re-proposal within 30 days)
packages/ai/src/embeddings.ts using India-only route with mock embedder and refused+audited non-India providers, plus static test that no fine-tuning/training client exists
embedding deletion within 24h job with test
flag m5_playbooks default off, on for demo workspace
registries (cross-tenant services incl. vector search, RLS catalog, db index.test, core-domains, worker registry)

requirements.why: Criteria text lives in #81: (1) passage saved only after confirmed L2 proposal, no write path without a confirmation record; (2) source draft version and anchor stored; (3) scope enforced in SQL, clerk denied, chamber-shared only if owner shared, no cross-tenant incl. vector search; (4) deleting passage/playbook removes memory_embedding rows within 24h, job tested; (5) no fine-tuning client in packages/ai (static test) and ADR states no-training; (6) embeddings India-only, non-India refused and audited; 13: flag m5_playbooks default off, on for demo workspace.

deliverables.change: Add M5 to MEMORY_LAYERS, LAYER_SCOPES (user, workspace), M5 keys (playbook, precedent, style prefs), passage kinds, dismissal reason codes, PrecedentProposalSchema {passageText, kind, courtId, sourceAnchor, confidence}; update header comment. Extend memory.test.ts.
Add M5 to MEMORY_LAYERS list and widen memory_item_shared_chk to M4 or M5.

New tenantTable precedent_passage (id, workspace_id, memory_item_id composite FK to memory_item, court_id, kind, language, body encrypted, source_draft_version_id, anchor_id, status active|retired|deleted) with checks and indexes; export from schema/index.ts.
Export precedent schema.

New migration at next free number (after 20261027114504_authority): drop/recreate memory_item and memory_proposal layer CHECKs with M5, widen shared CHECK, create precedent_passage with ws_isolation RLS (ENABLE+FORCE), restrictive owner/chamber-shared scope policy joined to memory_item, REVOKE ALL from causedeck_clerk, update app_memory_purge_targets if needed; generated snapshot/journal via db:generate; Reviewed-by header as in 20261026074215_memory.sql.

Embedding client over the India-only route: mock embedder default (dev/CI), provider embedders accepted only in India regions (use policy/residency.ts), non-India refused and audited via an injected audit sink; export from packages/ai/src/index.ts. No fine-tuning/training client.
Tests: mock embedder, India provider allowed, non-India refused and audited; static test scanning packages/ai/src for fine-tune/training client identifiers and endpoints.

Generate L2 PrecedentProposal from finalised exported drafts into memory_proposal only (status proposed); dismissal with reason code; no re-proposal of the same passage for 30 days; confirm path creates M5 memory_item and precedent_passage in one tx via confirmMemory.

saveConfirmedPassage (internal, requires confirmation record), search (SQL-scoped pgvector: owner or chamber-shared, clerk/viewer denied, workspace pinned), list, retire and delete (marks memory_item deleted so memory.purge removes embeddings), embed on confirm via ai embeddings.
Playbook model as M5 memory_item: preferred court format, standard prayers, annexure order; create/update only via confirm-before-save; delete removes embeddings.
Export m5 services (each runtime export must be registered in SERVICE_TESTS or NOT_A_SERVICE).
Audit refused non-India embedders; allow M5 items through a shared embed helper (matter_id null).
Register flag m5_playbooks (default off, non-legal-gated, owner [81, 901]); update any flags test enumerating keys.
Insert a workspace_feature_flag override enabling m5_playbooks for the demo workspace; extend seed/__tests__/demo-seed.test.ts.

ADR: style learning is selection and ranking of the lawyer's own approved passages; never trains or fine-tunes on customer data; India-only embeddings; confirm-before-save. Add to docs/adr/README.md index if it lists ADRs.
Document M5 in the memory row and add any new CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES edge (memory -> drafting only through its index.ts, if used).
Add precedent_passage to the root table list.
Add precedent_passage to the RLS catalog.
Register precedent_passage table test; add SERVICE_TESTS entries (or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason) for each new core export.
Add seedPrecedentPassage two-tenant seeder.
Real cases for new services (B on A denied or sees nothing; A unchanged), incl. vector search.
Cross-tenant and chamber-sharing/clerk cases for M5 passages and search.

Integration test (issue names packages/core/test/memory-m5.integration.test.ts; core has no test/ dir, so use this path unless vitest include admits test/): confirm-only write path, provenance stored, 30-day re-proposal block, clerk denied, chamber share, delete purges embeddings within the sweep.
Include precedent_passage in memory export and erasure (exporters.ts, deletion/erase.ts) and their tests if they enumerate memory tables.

decisions.choice: Reuse memory_item (layer M5) + memory_embedding and the existing memory.purge job instead of a new embedding table or job
decisions.justification: memory_embedding.item_id FK and purgeDeletedMemoryEmbeddings (packages/core/src/memory/embedding.ts:150-160) already delete vectors of status='deleted' items within the hourly sweep; avoids worker registry churn

decisions.choice: Encrypt precedent_passage.body with encryptField (AAD = workspace id) like memory_item.value_ciphertext
decisions.justification: Passages are privileged work product; memory_item stores values encrypted (packages/db/src/schema/memory.ts, value_ciphertext); similarity search runs on embeddings, so plaintext is not needed in SQL

decisions.choice: Place the integration test under packages/core/src/memory/__tests__ if core vitest does not include test/
decisions.justification: packages/core has no test/ directory; existing memory tests live in src/memory/__tests__

decisions.choice: Next ADR number 0046; playbooks/apply, style-profile, web pages and picker excluded (siblings #902-#904)
